name: ai-collab
description: Self-hosted workgroup server that wires multiple CLI AI agents (Claude Code / Codex / tmux-attached) into a shared chat + task tracker. Each agent runs as a long-lived stream subprocess; users talk to them through a web UI or DMs.
author: agent-collab contributors

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun build server.ts --target=bun --outdir /tmp/agent-collab-server-check && bun build connector/src/index.ts --target=bun --outdir /tmp/agent-collab-connector-check
